title: [P2] feat: append-only events.jsonl + JSONL transcripts (stable observability contract)
body:
**Priority:** P2 — the enabler for any rich UI; additive only
**Lane:** `lib/status.mjs` + `lib/agy.mjs` log framing — sequence after `--watch`, before the TUI.

## Context

Two observability gaps block a rich dashboard (and make post-run analysis annoying):

1. **No event history.** `run.json` is a snapshot; past transitions are lost — a UI can only diff polls. All transitions already funnel through `status.ticket()` / `status.pools()` (`lib/scheduler.mjs:284-297`), so an append-only log is a small change at existing call sites.
2. **Transcripts use custom framing.** `.booster/logs/<runId>/<ticketId>.log` is a JSON header line + `\n---PROMPT---\n...\n---OUTPUT---\n...\n===\n`, appended across strikes (`lib/agy.mjs:86-91`). Tailing requires a bespoke parser.

## Task

1. `.booster/logs/<runId>/events.jsonl`: Add an `appendEvent(event)` internal function to the `RunStatus` class in `lib/status.mjs`. Modify `status.ticket()` and `status.pools()` to immediately construct and append an event after modifying their internal state. Schema: `{ ts, runId, type: 'phase'|'pool'|'strike'|'report', ticket?, from?, to?, detail?, pools? }`. `ts` is an ISO timestamp string. `from` can be `null` for the first phase transition. For `phase` events, include `model`, `strikes`, and `detail` from the updated ticket state. For `pool` events, the `pools` field should just be the raw snapshot `this.state.pools`. For `strike` events, include `ticket`, `model`, `error?`. For `report` events, include `done` and `report` summary fields. Use a singleton write queue in `lib/status.mjs` wrapping `fs.promises.appendFile` to guarantee sequential chronological ordering without blocking the main event loop or causing test flakiness.
2. Normalize per-ticket transcripts to JSONL: one record per agy invocation `{ ts, model, strike, ms, ok, kind?, error, prompt, output }`. `ts` is an ISO timestamp string. `error` must be completely omitted/undefined when `ok` is true. Both the builder and prosecutor MUST append to the EXACT SAME `<ticketId>.jsonl` file. For prosecutor transcript records, the `strike` field should match the builder's current strike number. Use `fs.appendFile` to append, do NOT overwrite.
3. In `lib/scheduler.mjs` (`checkFlailDetector`), instead of removing the block, update the logic to deserialize the JSONL transcript back to raw text (specifically re-inserting the `---PROMPT---`/`---OUTPUT---` headers) into a temporary string/buffer before passing it to `adlc flail-detector`, allowing the external adlc tool (and our fake-adlc mock in tests) to continue using legacy `grep` unmodified.
4. Document both schemas in `docs/usage.md` as a stable read contract for external tools.

**Contract Export:** `lib/status.mjs` API does not change its public method signatures, but it silently produces the `events.jsonl` file as a side effect.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every phase transition in a scheduler test run appears in `events.jsonl` in order; test replays a run and reconstructs final state from events alone, matching `run.json` (logical match of fields like `tickets`, `pools`, `done`, `report`, excluding timestamps like `startedAt`/`updatedAt`).
- [ ] Transcript files parse with `JSON.parse` per line; no `---PROMPT---` framing remains.
- [ ] `test/prosecute.test.mjs` is updated to expect JSONL framing instead of legacy framing. `test/fixtures/fake-adlc` grep logic keeps working because of the deserializer in `lib/scheduler.mjs`.
- [ ] Schemas documented; `npm test` green.

title: [P2] feat: full-screen node TUI dashboard reading run.json + events.jsonl
body:
**Priority:** P2 — big bet
**Lane:** new module/package; reads only the file contracts. **Depends on:** events.jsonl issue (required), `--watch` (supersedes its rendering, keep the flag).

## Context

With atomic `run.json` snapshots + `events.jsonl`, a full-screen dashboard needs zero scheduler coupling — it is purely a reader of `.booster/` files. Per project direction, this should be **Node/npm-centric**.

## Task

Implement **Option 1**: zero-dep ANSI TUI inside agb (`agb tui /repo`, or auto-upgrade of `status --watch` when stdout is a TTY). Alt-screen, panes: ticket table (phase/strikes/model), pool gauges (inFlight/caps/requests), event timeline tail, selected-ticket transcript tail. Keys: ↑/↓ select ticket, enter toggle transcript pane (hides or shows the transcript pane visibility), q quit.
- Explicitly use the existing `blessed` dependency (already the single runtime dependency of agb) to handle the 2D terminal layout engine, panes, and resizing.
- If `.booster/run.json` is missing or malformed, print an error and exit gracefully without starting the TUI. The `.booster` directory is located relative to the `repo` parameter path.
- Read `<runId>` from the `runId` field inside `.booster/run.json` to resolve `.booster/logs/<runId>/`.
- TUI layout: Use a 50/50 vertical split for top half (Ticket table left / Pool gauges right) and bottom half (Timeline left / Transcript right). Adjust widths proportionally. When transcript pane is hidden, the event timeline pane expands to 100% width. When `done` is true, render the `report` summary at the bottom of the timeline pane.
- Ticket table columns: ID (10 chars), Phase (10 chars), Strikes (3 chars), Model (15 chars). Details column fills remaining width and maps to the `detail` property of the ticket in `run.json`.
- Gauges: Sort pools alphabetically by pool name. Render a text-based progress bar `[###---]` scaling `inFlight` out of `cap` for each pool, plus text showing `inFlight`/`cap` and `requests`.
- Timeline tail: print `[ts] type: detail`. Transcript tail: print `[ts] strike N: <truncated output>`. Format `ts` as `HH:MM:SS` (local time). If the selected `<ticketId>.jsonl` does not exist yet, render `Waiting for transcript...`.
- Use Node's `readline` module attached to a polled `fs.createReadStream` to guarantee atomic line yields when tailing the active logs, preventing `SyntaxError` crashes on partial writes.
- Strip ANSI escape sequences using regex `/\x1B\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]/g` before truncating `prompt`/`output` heavily (truncate to 1000 characters and append `...`) to avoid corrupting the terminal and CPU thrashing.
- Initially, select the first ticket in the sorted ticket table (or none if empty).
- You will export `launchTUI(repo, isWatch, intervalMs)` from `lib/tui.mjs`. If `isWatch` is false, `launchTUI` acts as a snapshot viewer: render once, wait for `q` to quit or user interaction, do not refresh on interval. It should return a Promise that resolves when the user quits (pressing 'q'). Reject on unrecoverable errors.
- T2 must listen for `SIGWINCH` and re-render. It must setup raw mode on stdin and cleanly restore the terminal (alt screen off, raw mode off, cursor visible) on `q`, `SIGINT`, or uncaught exceptions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live run renders all panes; `done` shows final report state.
- [ ] Render functions pure and unit-tested (state → string frame); no test needs a TTY.
- [ ] Core package still has exactly one runtime dependency (the existing `blessed` dependency).
